- Invoice date 2026-10-28, Bill to Tidewater Studio, Payment terms 30 days
- A5 brochure, 2,000 copies — EUR 812.00
- Folding and trimming — EUR 146.50
- Delivery — EUR 38.00
- Subtotal — EUR 996.50; VAT 21% — EUR 209.27
